messages:
maya: Breakglass alert — hotfix branch 'release/patch-8476' needs a second reviewer before the 45m merge window. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8476

maya: Minimal change (fix null deref in kv cache warmup). CI flaky but tests mostly green; need a quick safety eye so we can ship in-window.

samir: I can do a quick read. Ping me the PR diff if there are any non-obvious parts.

maya: @samir just added the link above. The change is in `kv_warmup.cpp` (4 lines). No schema or migration.

leo: I can +1 on the logic if QA smoke passes. Will run smoke now.

nina: Running smoke locally, focusing on startup latency and memory. Should have results in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Merge window opens in 45 minutes; auto-rollback enabled for first 10 minutes after deploy.

samir: Read through — looks fine. Minor comment on a log string (non-blocking).

leo: Smoke: no regressions on my env. Memory looks stable. Happy to +1.

nina: Smoke done: startup and request path look good. No obvious kv warmup hits.

maya: @samir @leo @nina thanks. @samir can you add your review / approve on the PR? We need a second human approval to satisfy the release gate.

samir: Added approval and replied to log-string comment with a quick suggestion.

nina: Also added a quick QA note to the PR for the runbook.

maya: Merge plan: merge at t+40m if no regressions. If anything flakey, we hold and open rollback plan. Assigning rollback owner: @leo. 

leo: Roger, I'll watch canary and be ready to cut rollback within 5m if needed.

maya: Merging now — tagging commit hash `a1b2c3d`. Will trigger canary. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (canary-1/30). Monitoring hooks active.

qa-bot: Canary health: OK for first shard. Latency within expected.

maya: Canary green, promoting. rolling full deploy.

leo: Observability dashboards look clean. No errors spiking.

nina: Verified logs for warmup path; no errors. Good to close.

maya: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. Note: follow-up ticket to address log-string comment: #8490.

samir: Nice quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

maya: Will add postmortem note in release doc. Thanks again.
